0.1.23: When you are online, your recap can show up to three fixes. Use the arrows to see each one, and tap the speaker to hear it.
The Skills grew card now shows which blocks are from today and which are from your talks before.
When no skill grew in a talk, the recap shows you one skill to try next time.
0.1.22: Ella now has short lessons for you. When you get stuck on something, or after two good talks, your lesson is ready on Home.
In a lesson, Ella helps you practise one thing: she praises what you get right and helps you fix the rest, step by step.
You can also start your lesson from Ella's card on Talk partners.
Lessons need the internet. When you are offline, Ella keeps your lesson for later.
0.1.21: Ella starts answering a little sooner after you stop speaking.
When the internet is slow or drops for a moment, Ella gets back to you faster.
Long answers are not lost any more. Ella keeps what you said, and after 45 seconds she reminds you to finish.
On Windows, updates install more smoothly.
